description: This Java class 'EtbResearch' provides an interface for manually testing and adjusting the Electronic Throttle Body (ETB) by incrementally changing duty cycle values. It manages the process through GUI interaction (button), threaded execution, sensor feedback, and command confirmation listeners to automate ETB movement for diagnostic purposes.

classes.name: EtbResearch
classes.description: Provides UI and logic to perform ETB duty cycle testing and adjustment based on sensor feedback for diagnostic purposes.

methods.description: Resets duty cycle and tracking variables to initial states.
